long_biography.plain_text:
Al Moosa was born in 1967 and graduated from Seattle Pacific University in 1993 with bachelor's degrees in computer science and business administration. He became chief executive of two Dubai property companies: United Emirates Real Estate and Ahmed Abdullah Al Moosa Real Estate. The latter was established by the heirs of its namesake to manage, preserve and grow family property assets.

Under the Al Moosa board, the business manages residential and commercial properties and provides leasing, brokerage, facilities-management and owners-association services. Al Moosa also sits on Dubai Insurance's board, where disclosures show him serving on the nomination and remuneration committee and chairing oversight of insider transactions. His public career combines direct property management with long-term corporate governance in insurance.
